description:
Implement the Server-Sent Events endpoint per RFC 8620 §7.3 (the EventSource resource).

- GET /events streams a text/event-stream of StateChange events from the MemoryBackends' change-tracking machinery.
- Honor the 'types', 'closeafter', and 'ping' query parameters per the RFC.
- StateChange JSON shape per RFC 8620 §7.4.

The change-tracking surface that the testjig taps into is the state-counter / change-log infrastructure that every MemoryBackend already maintains. The testjig needs a way to subscribe to all 8 backends' state changes and emit a unified StateChange event.

If the MemoryBackends don't currently expose a 'subscribe' API, this slice may need to add a polling loop (e.g. tokio interval that diffs get_state across types each second) as a minimum-viable approach, with a follow-up bead for proper signalling.

## Acceptance

- GET /events returns text/event-stream
- After a Space/set update via POST /jmap, the SSE client receives a StateChange event naming the changed type
- 'closeafter=state' parameter behavior matches RFC 8620 §7.3
- 'ping' parameter emits keep-alive events at the requested interval
- cargo clippy / cargo test workspace clean

## Depends on .3 (MemoryBackend wiring)
